Question: Can some meat of qurbani be given to our non-Muslim servants? Answer ID: 146479 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 217/207/B=3/1438) If you are sure that he is asking for eating then you may give Qurbani meat to non-Muslim, it is allowable as per the Shariah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
